notes.title: DQ Heroes II Content Updates
notes.content:
The latest free content update for Dragon Quest Heroes II is now live!
We hope you've been enjoying the recent free updates but in case you haven't been able to keep up so far we have released:

[b][u]6 Side Stories[/u][/b]
- Maribel & Ruff
- Torneko
- Terry & Carver
- Maya & Meena
- Jessica & Angelo
- Alena & Kiryl 
[b][u]1 Boss Map[/u][/b]
- Estark
[b][u]Quest for a new co-op spell[/u][/b]
- Quest for Kazapple
[b][u]4 New characters to use in multiplayer[/u][/b]
- Luceus
- Aurora
- Bianca
- Nera

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28154712/d6425566640acff721b67144724030a0d57ab214.jpg[/img]
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28154712/5f35e6daf86a0d96b700bd5898def2d80ee41eaf.jpg[/img]
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28154712/f17b5c74bb804033192cdb535e7ceea2d5302ed7.jpg[/img]

There's still more to come and we hope you're enjoying all of the new content!

notes.title: Free Updates Coming to DQ Heroes II!
notes.content:
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28154712/9418c623949c38789df31cc62a1eede1c59355ed.jpg[/img]
Starting from today, we are adding brand new content to Dragon Quest Heroes II for FREE! This content includes new side-stories that delve deeper into the colourful cast of characters, a host of exclusive Slime weapons and various new content for multiplayer mode.
The image above gives you a good overview of what content is being added and when. The first update which is available right now, brings two new side-stories featuring three veteran characters from the series:
[list]
[*][b]Maribel & Ruff Side-story[/b]
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28154712/051aa56aa025c35997d0becab300d71fbed87998.jpg[/img]
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28154712/7ec4e807e3d0185fddf3e03eeeddb820adf8f0c4.jpg[/img]
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28154712/870051beb46397c8c6c6f53cb53db47733011ea2.jpg[/img]
[*][b]Torneko Side-story[/b]
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28154712/8d273b264ed777aa13cae80410a64d692eb816a6.png[/img]
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28154712/d3a2fd382baced5e06ee6e4c514faf7e2da218e5.jpg[/img]
[/list]
If you'd like to get to know these heroes a bit better then do check out our "Meet the Heroes" video series - [url=https://youtu.be/IgVhEXJ8dYU]Maribel & Ruff[/url] and [url=https://youtu.be/tI1O2nmwq9Y]Torneko[/url].

Be sure to give us a follow and like on [url=http://www.facebook.com/DragonQuest]Facebook[/url], [url=https://twitter.com/dragonquest]Twitter[/url] and [url=https://www.youtube.com/channel/UCVz19v62F_lOImHxDM_rnsA]YouTube![/url]

notes.title: Update on Steam Trading Cards
notes.content:
[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28154712/4874e47ede688f4b5ffd324a4569b9b59d9f53bf.png[/img]
EDIT: Steam Trading Cards are now available. We’re also adding an in game option to quickly exit out of the game on 25th May 2017. Thanks for playing Dragon Quest Heroes II! 

=====

Dragon Quest Heroes II has just been released on Steam and we hope you’re all enjoying the game so far!
You may have noticed that Steam Trading Cards are missing from the game but don’t worry, we will be adding them to the game as soon as possible. 

On a side note, when playing in full screen mode, if you want to quit the game quickly, the easiest way to do this is to press Alt-Tab and close the program if you have a keyboard ready. 

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28154712/7f5417b02b2231323dcecceb18bc112e65849ab5.jpg[/img]

If you wish to enjoy the authentic Dragon Quest feeling then speak to the Chapel tender and end your adventure (you can also save your game here). A bit later into the game, you’ll have to cast the Zoom or Evac spell to return to Accordia to get to the Chapel too.

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28154712/09d472438b213bd34a8795dc944bb460cc347f29.jpg[/img]

That’s it for now but let us know if you run into any problems and we hope you enjoy Dragon Quest Heroes II!

notes.title: Pre-load Dragon Quest Heroes II today!
notes.content:
Hello Heroes! Good news - starting right now you can pre-load Dragon Quest Heroes II on Steam!

We often get asked about what kind of graphical options our games on Steam are going to have at launch so here's a list of all available options for you:

[b][u]Game Settings[/u][/b]
Full Screen Display: On or Off
Resolution:
[list]
[*] 630 x 360
[*] 800 x 450
[*] 1024 x 576
[*] 1280 x 720
[*] 1360 x 765
[*] 1600 x 900
[*] 1920 x 1080
[*] 2560 x 1440
[*] 2560 x 1600
[*] 3840 x 2160
[/list]
Frame Rate: 20, 30 or 60
Movies: On or Off
Controller: You can switch between select with A or B (and cancel with B or A)

[b][u]Quality Settings[/u][/b]
Number of On-Screen Characters: High, Medium or Low
Draw Distance: High, Medium or Low
Textures: High, Medium or Low
Shadows: High, Medium, Low or Off
Ambient Occlusion: High, Medium, Low or Off
Reflections: High, Medium, Low or Off
Light Shafts: On or Off
Particles: High, Medium or Low
Global Illumination: High, Medium or Low
Volumetric Fog: On or Off
Point Light Shadows: On or Off

And here are the keyboard settings:

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28154712/f8ed939e077d0ee8f8306bbc50072fd7aef6756d.jpg[/img]
[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28154712/86ae1039213c068c05f54458b596a9a17fa8466a.jpg[/img]

Don't forget Dragon Quest Heroes II will be released this coming Tuesday, 25th April 2017. We hope you all enjoy playing it!

YouTube: www.youtube.com/dragonquest
